decisions.reason: Mobile PDF signing fits the firm's push toward online contract signing and costs little to maintain, although its absence from the website in 2020–2021 suggests lower emphasis.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture underpins the integrated security platform and is likely being marketed under other names rather than abandoned.
The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche feature that has disappeared from the website, so its resources are better used for the core secure identity and communication platform.
The QR hardware token still serves banking customers needing PSD2-compliant transaction authorization, though app-based authentication is reducing hardware demand.
Payment security compliance remains relevant to regulated customers and draws on core expertise, but its low visibility makes it a candidate for consolidation.
